title: ScanMyCard - Card Scanner
shortDescription: AI business card scanner. Save cards to contacts and export to Excel in seconds.
fullDescription:
Back from an expo, meeting or trade fair with a pocket full of visiting cards? Snap them with ScanMyCard. The AI reads every card, you check the details, and your contacts are saved, organised and ready to export to Excel.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Snap the cards one after another with your camera, or pick photos from your gallery.
2. AI (powered by Google Gemini) reads up to 8 fields from each card in a few seconds: name, company, designation, phone, email, website, country and address.
3. Review each card, fix anything you like, and save. Export to Excel and share it on WhatsApp, email or Google Drive.

SCAN THE WHOLE STACK
• Scan card after card without stopping, or pick many photos from your gallery at once
• Works with portrait and landscape cards, plain or busy designs
• Cards that can't be read are not charged, and your credit is given back automatically

SAVE AND CONNECT
• Save any contact straight to your phone's contacts. If a card has two numbers, choose one or save both
• Open a WhatsApp chat with a contact in one tap
• Call or email directly from the contact page

ORGANISE YOUR CONTACTS
• Folders for each fair, city, client or team
• Add notes and tags to remember where you met and what to follow up
• Search by name, company, notes or tags
• Duplicate check warns you when a card is already saved, so you can skip it or update the old one
• Edit any saved contact at any time
• Select many contacts to move or delete them together

EXPORT TO EXCEL
• Export all contacts, or just one folder, as an .xlsx file
• Includes notes and tags, ready for your CRM or your team's sheet
• Share on WhatsApp, email, Google Drive or any app on your phone

YOUR ACCOUNT, ON ANY PHONE
• Sign in with Google or email
• Your contacts are saved to your account, so they are still there when you change phones
• Notifications when scans finish, credits run low or a payment goes through

MADE FOR
Sales and business development teams, exporters and importers, real-estate agents, pharma reps, event organisers, founders, freelancers and anyone who collects visiting cards.

SIMPLE PRICING, NO SURPRISES
• 10 free scans when you verify your email
• 1 credit = 1 card. Buy a pack only when you need it
• Credits never expire
• Packs start at ₹99 + GST for 50 cards, down to ₹0.60 per card on larger packs
• Personal and Business packs available
• Pay securely with UPI, cards, net banking or wallets through Razorpay

INVITE FRIENDS
Share your referral code. You get 10 free scans for every friend who joins, and your friend gets 5 extra scans.

PRIVACY
Your contacts belong to you. We don't sell your data. You can delete your account and all your data from inside the app or at scanmycard.in/delete-account.

Need help? Write to support@scanmycard.in or visit scanmycard.in

ScanMyCard is made in India by WeCanServe.
